message:
Operator-directed finding (2026-11-19): The route to completing stateful Work/Telos is UNDERSPECIFIED as an executable delivery plan. This is YOUR responsibility as Jarvis Lead. Do not defer planning to Manager, Workers, Integrator or Operator, and do not treat the existence of detailed architecture/specs or repeated HOLD labels as a completion plan.

Evidence: canonical Lead task has detailed GO/HOLD and current Worker 10/18/22/23 lanes, but no end-to-end dependency-to-delivery plan with concrete next producer/owner and exit gate for every remaining critical-path node. The Work epic has B/C/D/E/F/G/H/I architecture and G0-G6 acceptance; docs/specs/work-stateful-implementation-alignment-2026-11-17.md defines work packages and gates; docs/specs/work-sqlite-domain-backup-contract-2026-11-17.md already defines a full two-project positive fixture and rejection/recovery matrix. Those are useful and should be reused, NOT re-specified as new process. Yet original Git source/effect C -> authenticated typed SQLite ingress B is not resolved into an explicit positive producer-consumer handoff. B (Workers 15/20) gates F (Worker 13), G (Worker 12), and eventual E (Worker 1)/H (Worker 2). work-stateful-e2e-release (I) is Open, unassigned, and offers high-level tests but no assigned delivery/admission plan.

Required action: Own and continuously maintain one CURRENT dependency-ordered Work completion plan in the canonical Lead task/appropriate epic, not just a status narrative. For EACH unfinished critical-path milestone specify (1) precise missing capability/proof, (2) concrete minimal producer task plus accountable owner/source lease, (3) incoming/outgoing dependencies and objective unblock trigger, (4) independently verifiable acceptance/integration gate, (5) next Manager dispatch priority, and (6) fallback/decision branch if investigation disproves an assumed mechanism. First prioritize the C->B producer/consumer chain: explicitly plan both outcomes of Worker 23's object-visibility investigation, including a composition-with-existing-Git-read path if sufficient and a tightly scoped implementer if not. Connect Workers 4/21 C evidence to Workers 15/20 B implementation; advance independent default-off B/E/F/G/H preparations where technically possible instead of serializing everything behind final acceptance. Establish an accountable final I milestone, exact integrated acceptance matrix, positive two-project backup/restore and stale-Recovery rehearsals, and operator-controlled migration/rollback checkpoints; preserve independent review, source provenance, genuine Release evidence and existing explicit live cutover HOLD.

You own prioritization, decomposition, task specifications, assignments, dependency resolution, and refreshing the runnable worker frontier. Manager mechanically launches only Lead-approved Ready assignments; idle workers and repeated HOLDs must prompt concrete source-grounded investigation or an explicit truly operator-reserved decision, not passive waiting. You may create/revise canonical tasks, assign eligible Workers and specify ordered Manager dispatch under existing authority. Do not use this note as authorization to merge unreviewed work or deploy/restart/migrate/activate Scheduler; operator approval for cutover remains required.

Please implement the planning correction in canonical state, not merely acknowledge this notification.
